修剪留有余量，宁长勿短（加长比截短容易）。: Leave margin when trimming: better too long than too short (lengthening is easier than cutting).
测量时天线置于最终架设高度与位置，避免环境影响误判。: Measure with the antenna at its final height and position, so the environment does not mislead you.
用天线分析仪扫频，找到谐振点与驻波最低频率。: Sweep with an antenna analyser to find the resonance and the frequency of lowest SWR.
确认目标频率驻波比 < 2（理想 < 1.5），带宽满足需要。: Confirm SWR < 2 on the target frequency (ideally < 1.5) and that the bandwidth is adequate.
谐振频率偏高说明天线偏短，偏低说明偏长。: A resonant frequency that is too high means the antenna is too short; too low means it is too long.
边测边记，避免来回反复。: Record as you measure, to avoid going back and forth.
逐次少量修剪或加长振子，每次后重新扫频。: Trim or lengthen the element a little at a time, re-sweeping after each change.
馈线长度也会影响测量，尽量用分析仪直接测天线端。: Feedline length also affects the measurement, so measure at the antenna end with the analyser where possible.
